criteria: Specify which transformations identify arrangements.

criteria: Check the strict longest-side condition and positivity.

set.name: Feasibility of four quadrilateral sides

criteria: Match each opposite side with its angle, distinguish an exterior turn from the included triangle angle, and use the cosine law with any allowed real angle cosine, not only 0 or 1/2.

Recover a positive side length or an angle cosine from compatible side data, or eliminate unknown cosines between triangles. Retain every feasible solution and reject negative lengths, degenerate triangles and cosines outside (-1,1).
set.description: For a nondegenerate Euclidean triangle, use c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab*cos(C) with matched sides and included angle. Recover a side or angle cosine, or combine compatible triangle equations; check geometric and solution feasibility.
set.name: General cosine-law applications in triangles
set.nameZh: 一般三角形的余弦定理应用

criteria: Find zeros of simple functions.
For a continuous real function on a closed interval, use opposite endpoint signs to guarantee at least one interior zero; sign change alone does not imply a zero without continuity.
set.description: 知道函数零点就是方程 f(x)=0 的实根，也是图象与 x 轴交点的横坐标。
set.name: Zeros of Functions
